templates.source: https://lilin.zendesk.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360045653451-LILIN-IP-Camera-RTSP-Information — LILIN Technical Support KB "LILIN IP Camera RTSP Information": "/stream0 - Encoder 1 (typically the camera's primary HD stream)", example rtsp://admin:pass@192.168.1.200/stream0, default RTSP port 554.

https://lilin.zendesk.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360045653451-LILIN-IP-Camera-RTSP-Information — LILIN Technical Support KB "LILIN IP Camera RTSP Information": "/stream1 - Encoder 2 (typically the camera's secondary SD stream)". LILIN KB 115003156583 (Control4 / M Series) also shows Encoder2's default RTSP name as 'stream1'.

unverified_leads.note: Legacy firmware-1.x LILIN codec+resolution naming (e.g. /rtsph2641080p, /rtsph264720p, /rtsph2644k per older LILIN KB 212217363, now no longer published). The <res> suffix is model/encoder-specific with no single documented default, so it cannot be a fixed template; current LILIN cameras default to /stream0 and /stream1.
Legacy MJPEG sibling of /rtsph264<res> (e.g. /rtspjpeg480p); resolution suffix is model-specific with no documented default.

sub_/main_ channel form — LILIN NVR/DVR uses a different scheme (/rtspstream?channel=<ch>&stream=<n>, per LILIN's official GitHub NVR RTSP SDK), not the standalone-IP-camera rtsph264 scheme; not confirmed for cameras.
See main_[CHANNEL] note — LILIN DVR/NVR channel form, not the IP-camera path.
Generic/cross-brand MPEG4 path; not found in any official LILIN IP-camera doc.

notes: Current LILIN IP cameras name each encoder's RTSP path /stream<N> counted from 0 (/stream0 = Encoder 1 main, /stream1 = Encoder 2 sub), default RTSP port 554, RTSP over HTTP on port 80 also documented; the live URL of every encoder is listed in the camera web GUI (Setup > Video/Audio) and the names are editable. Legacy firmware-1.x cameras used codec+resolution names (/rtsph264<res>, /rtspjpeg<res>) — kept as unverified leads because the suffix has no single default. A separate E-Series line uses /av0_0 and /av0_1 (UserManual_ESeries_IPC-EN.pdf); LILIN DVR/NVR use /rtspstream?channel=<ch>&stream=<n>. See also strix/verified/lilin.json.
